svg.title: Yuzen — logo specification
svg.text: A glazed Y: celadon lit from the upper left, a highlight on the left arm, a darker run of thicker glaze down the right arm and stem.
Clear space: the dashed square, built into every SVG viewBox
(about one arm width on every side of the letter).
Minimum size: 32 px for the full mark;
The highlight sits on the left arm and the run on
the right: never mirror the mark.
Glaze: linear, from the top left of the letter to the foot of the stem.
Run: vertical, top to foot. Highlight: white at 20 % opacity.
